lines: I started Notion back in 2013, and since then we've raised over $600 million in funding.
At Notion, we've grown the team to more than 14,000 people across the globe.
Notion has secured a total of about $343 million in funding from incredible investors like Sequoia Capital and Index Ventures.
Last year, our YoY growth was a little over 51%, which we're really proud of.
I was Head of Product at Inkling before starting Notion, wahaan kaafi kuch seekha maine.
Our current headcount is just over 7,000, but we're about to cross 10,000 very soon!
